system.description: You plant a golden banner or a staff of white wood and scream a command into the void, forbidding the Reaper to claim any more souls this day.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and when the 24 hours end, the test is Toughness DR16.
outcomes.success: In a 100' radius around the ritual site, no living creature can die for 24 hours. When the time runs out, the weight of fate returns: anyone who should have died tests Toughness DR20 or dies as the delayed end catches them.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the Reaper does not listen.
outcomes.ruin: The Reaper listens, and takes note of you: you are Doomed. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
